main_track.starting_gate: Mobile Auto Start (8 horses max front tier)
main_track.bias_notes: A classic half-mile 'bullring' track with tight turns and an exceptionally short 400-foot home stretch. NO PASSING LANE is present at Yonkers, creating the infamous 'Pocket Trap'—horses sitting 2-hole along the rail can easily get boxed in if the front-runner tires. Early gate position is paramount; over 75% of winners are positioned 1st, 2nd, or 3rd at the 1/4 pole.
main_track.post_bias: Posts 1 through 4 hold a massive statistical advantage (~75% win share). Post 8 is designated as 'The Death Trap' with a historically abysmal win rate (<4%). Outside runners face extreme ground loss rounding tight turns.

post_1.tactical_note: Rail advantage. Crucial for establishing early lead or holding the 2-hole pocket trip.

post_2.tactical_note: Highest flat-bet ROI post. Ideal angle to press for the lead or tuck behind Post 1.

post_3.tactical_note: Allows driver to evaluate gate speed inside and secure a top 3 position before Turn 1.

post_4.tactical_note: Solid launching spot; last barrier draw in the preferred inside tier.

post_5.tactical_note: Requires aggressive early drive ('sending') to avoid getting caught out 2-wide.

post_6.tactical_note: Wide angle into Turn 1. Needs strong early gate speed or cover flow to contend.

post_7.tactical_note: High risk of getting parked out wide. Requires class edge or suicidal inside pace collapse.

post_8.tactical_note: Statistically the toughest starting post in North American harness racing. Automatic downgrade.

Early_Speed_E.description: Massive Advantage. Wire-to-wire and front-end control are the primary path to winning at Yonkers.

Presser_EP.description: Strong Advantage. Pocket sitters (2-hole) and 1st-over chargers control the outer flow.

Stalker_P.description: Slight Disadvantage. Mid-pack stalkers need a blistering early pace duel to melt the leaders.

Swooper_S.description: Severe Penalty. Deep closers attempting to loop 3-wide or 4-wide around tight half-mile turns concede impossible ground.

handicapping_angles.the_half_mile_bias: Heavily downgrade deep closers ('S' types). If a horse cannot leave the gate quickly or secure a top-3 spot by the 1/4 pole, it is virtually impossible to loop the field 3-wide on tight turns.
handicapping_angles.the_pocket_trap_risk: Because Yonkers has NO passing lane (no open stretch), pocket sitters sitting 2nd on the rail behind a tiring leader risk getting locked in. Upgrade 1st-over (uncovered) outer-flow chargers who control their own destiny.
handicapping_angles.the_big_track_shipper_trap: Apply extreme caution to horses shipping in from 1-mile (Meadowlands) or 7/8-mile (Mohawk) tracks. Even with superior raw speed figures, long-striding harness horses frequently struggle with Yonkers' tight turns and break stride or lose momentum.
handicapping_angles.driver_aggressiveness: With no passing lane and a 400-foot stretch, heavily upgrade aggressive catch drivers (e.g., Bartlett, Brennan, Stratton, Kakaley, Bongiorno) who 'send' hard off the gate to establish early position.
handicapping_angles.the_first_quarter_blitz: Prioritize starters with proven sub-27.4 first-quarter gate speed. At Yonkers, the race is frequently won or lost in the first 220 yards.
handicapping_angles.trotting_gait_vulnerability: Trotters are twice as likely to break stride ('x') when navigating Yonkers' tight turns under pressure. Heavily penalize trotters with documented gait instability on half-mile tracks.
handicapping_angles.purse_class_drop: Yonkers offers premier purse levels (Borgata, Open Handicap). Horses dropping out of Yonkers Open/NW$15,000 ranks into regional tracks (Monticello, Freehold, Saratoga) hold an overwhelming class advantage.

shipper_conversion_rules.from_Meadowlands_M: Raw speed figures degrade by 2.5 to 3.0 seconds due to 1-mile vs 1/2-mile geometry. Verify horse handles tight turns.
shipper_conversion_rules.from_Woodbine_Mohawk_WBS: High class translation, but penalize long striders unused to 400-foot home lane.
shipper_conversion_rules.from_Pocono_PCD: Pocono 5/8-mile speed translates well; watch for post-position differential.
shipper_conversion_rules.from_Monticello_MR: Monticello regional winners face a steep class step (+6 to +8 lengths) when stepping up to Yonkers.
